name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
summary: Direct financial support for landholding farming families across India.
benefit: ₹6,000 per year transferred in 3 equal installments into the bank account.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families with cultivable land in their name. Institutional landholders and high-income taxpayers excluded.
howToApply: Online via pmkisan.gov.in portal or CSC center.

name: AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver (TFW) Scheme
summary: 100% tuition fee waiver for meritorious students from economically weaker families entering technical courses.
benefit: Full tuition fee waiver for the duration of the degree/diploma program (worth ~₹80,000/year).
eligibility: Students appearing in or passed Class 12 seeking admission into AICTE-approved engineering/technical colleges. Family annual income must be below ₹8,00,000.
howToApply: Select the TFW category option during State / Central engineering admission counselling (e.g. MP DTE).
timing: During MP DTE counselling after Class 12 (typically June-August)

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana
summary: Monthly financial aid to empower married, widowed, and abandoned women in Madhya Pradesh.
benefit: ₹1,250 per month (₹15,000 per year) directly credited to DBT-enabled bank account.
eligibility: Resident women of MP aged between 21 and 60 years who are married, widowed, divorced, or separated. Family annual income under ₹2.5 Lakh; no income taxpayers in family.
documents: Samagra Family ID and Member ID
Bank Account with active Aadhaar DBT link
howToApply: Submit form at gram panchayat camps, ward offices, or designated village camps.

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana (MMVY)
summary: State scholarship covering complete college tuition fees for meritorious students from MP.
benefit: Full course tuition fees paid directly to the recognized institution.
eligibility: MP domicile students with 70% or higher in MP Board (or 85%+ in CBSE/ICSE) in Class 12, family income under ₹6,00,000/year, admitted into approved degree courses.
howToApply: Online registration through MP Scholarship Portal 2.0.
timing: During MP state counselling and college admission window

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
summary: Government-backed small deposit savings scheme with high interest and tax benefits for girl children.
benefit: High guaranteed interest rate (8.2%), exempt-exempt-exempt tax status, compound wealth accumulation.
eligibility: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child aged under 10 years at the time of account opening. Maximum 2 accounts per family.
howToApply: At any nearest Post Office branch or authorized commercial bank.
timing: Apply before the girl child turns 10 years old

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
summary: Monthly pension for destitute elderly citizens living below the poverty line.
benefit: ₹600 to ₹1,000 monthly pension transferred to bank or post office account (₹7,200 to ₹12,000/year).
eligibility: Citizens aged 60 years or above belonging to a household categorized as Below Poverty Line (BPL).
documents: Age proof certificate / School leaving or Voter ID
BPL Ration Card / BPL Survey certificate
howToApply: Offline application at Gram Panchayat, Janpad Panchayat, or Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
summary: World's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme offering cashless hospital treatment.
benefit: Cashless hospitalization coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year at empaneled hospitals.
eligibility: Families identified under SECC / BPL databases and Antyodaya beneficiaries. Senior citizens 70+ also covered universally.
howToApply: Check name online on beneficiary.nha.gov.in and generate Ayushman Card at nearest CSC or empaneled hospital kiosk.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
summary: Financial assistance to students from Other Backward Classes to pursue higher education beyond Class 10.
benefit: Maintenance allowance and reimbursement of non-refundable tuition fees (approx ₹6,000 to ₹12,000/year).
eligibility: Students belonging to the OBC category studying in post-matriculation courses (Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Graduation) with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh.
documents: Caste Certificate (OBC) issued by authorized authority
Current Course Admission Proof and Fee Receipt
howToApply: Online via National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or MP State Scholarship Portal.
timing: Opens annually in July-October with academic sessions

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
summary: Deposit-free LPG connection provided to adult women from poor households.
benefit: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove provided without cost, plus ongoing targeted subsidy.
eligibility: Adult woman belonging to a BPL, SC/ST, or rural deprived household having no prior LPG connection.
documents: Aadhaar Card of applicant and adult family members
BPL Ration Card or SECC proof
howToApply: Submit form online at pmuy.gov.in or directly at nearest LPG gas distributor.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
summary: Financial grant for the construction of a pucca house with basic amenities in rural areas.
benefit: Financial grant of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas (₹1,30,000 in hilly areas) transferred directly in stages.
eligibility: Houseless families or those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in rural villages as identified by gram sabha and Awaas+ list.
howToApply: Registration conducted through Gram Panchayat via the AwaasSoft portal by village officials.
timing: Subject to Gram Panchayat survey and beneficiary priority list

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Comprehensive crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest.
benefit: Full financial claim settlement for crop loss with highly subsidized farmer premium (1.5% to 2%).
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including sharecroppers and tenant farmers with landholding records.
howToApply: Enroll via bank branch where KCC is held, through pmfby.gov.in portal, or CSC before season deadline.
timing: Seasonal windows: July 31 for Kharif, December 31 for Rabi

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
summary: Government life insurance scheme offering ₹2 Lakh death benefit at an affordable annual premium of ₹436.
benefit: ₹2,00,000 life insurance cover payable to nominee on death of the subscriber.
eligibility: Individuals aged 18 to 50 years who have a savings bank or post office account with auto-debit consent.
documents: Bank or Post Office savings account passbook
howToApply: Submit simple auto-debit enrollment form at your bank branch or via NetBanking/Mobile Banking.
timing: Annual renewal window in May; can join anytime with auto-debit

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
summary: Accidental insurance scheme offering up to ₹2 Lakh accident death and disability cover for ₹20 per year.
benefit: ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or total permanent disability; ₹1,00,000 for partial permanent disability.
eligibility: Individuals aged 18 to 70 years holding an active savings bank account with consent for annual auto-debit of ₹20.
howToApply: Enroll through your savings bank branch or Internet Banking with auto-debit option.
timing: Always open, annual auto-renewal each year on May 31

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
summary: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension scheme aimed at unorganized sector workers.
benefit: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month starting after attaining 60 years of age.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years holding a savings bank account who are not taxpayers.
documents: Bank Savings Account linked with Aadhaar and mobile
howToApply: Apply online via NetBanking or submit APY form to any bank or post office branch.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
summary: One-time lump sum grant provided to a BPL family upon the unfortunate death of the primary breadwinner.
benefit: One-time financial assistance of ₹20,000 paid to the surviving household head.
eligibility: BPL family upon the death of the primary breadwinner aged between 18 and 59 years.
howToApply: Submit claim at the office of Janpad Panchayat / SDM within 6 months of death.
timing: Within 6 months of the unfortunate event

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
summary: Holistic support including skill training, modern toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit for traditional artisans and craftspersons.
benefit: Free skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit e-voucher, and subsidized loans at 5% interest.
eligibility: Traditional artisans and craftsmen working in 18 specified trades (carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, potter, mason, tailor, etc.) aged 18+. One member per family.
documents: Active Mobile number linked with Aadhaar
howToApply: Biometric verification and application through nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
